mintAuthority.summary: RLUSD Ethereum minting is gated by Ripple's custom 2-of-31 MultiSign minter. The proxy creation calldata and current role reads identify separate 7-of-12 Ripple MultiSign contracts for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. The XRPL issuer account has its master key active and no signer list.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum minter - Ripple MultiSign contract (2-of-31)
controls.evidence: RLUSD ETH (0x8292) is a StablecoinProxy (UUPS), implementation StablecoinUpgradeableV2 at 0x9747a0d261c2d56eb93f542068e5d1e23170fa9e. hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x97e9) = true (MINTER_ROLE bytes32 obtained via MINTER_ROLE() getter 0xd5391393). Contract 0x97e9 verified on Blockscout as Ripple's MultiSign (EIP-712 multisig): signers() returns 31 addresses, quorum() = 2, each signerWeight = 1, nonce = 350. No GnosisSafe module structure — custom Ripple EIP-712 multisig.

controls.label: RLUSD XRPL issuer account (Ripple master key)
controls.evidence: XRPL account_info for rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De: Flags = 0x819a0000 (RequireDestTag, DisallowXRP, DefaultRipple, DepositAuth SET; NoFreeze NOT set; GlobalFreeze NOT set). RegularKey = none. No signer_list present. Master key active; XRPL issuance fully controlled by Ripple. Total XRPL RLUSD obligations = 761,696,376 RLUSD.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum role-admin MultiSign (7-of-12)
controls.evidence: RLUSD proxy initialization calldata assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to 0x66fc. At block 25530195, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x66fc) returned true; the verified Ripple MultiSign reports quorum 7 and 12 signers. This role can grant and revoke mint-critical roles.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum upgrader MultiSign (7-of-12)
controls.evidence: RLUSD proxy initialization calldata assigns UPGRADER_ROLE to 0x863c. At block 25530195, hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x863c) returned true; the verified Ripple MultiSign reports quorum 7 and the same 12-signer set as the role-admin MultiSign.

review.evidence: ETH: MINTER_ROLE holder is 0x97e9 (Ripple MultiSign, quorum 2 of 31). The proxy creation calldata names 0x66fc as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and 0x863c as UPGRADER_ROLE; current hasRole reads at block 25530195 confirm both assignments, and both verified MultiSign contracts report quorum 7 of 12. XRPL: issuer rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De has its master key active and no signer list.
